headline.en: See what occupies your context window.
headline.zh: 看清上下文窗口被什么占用。

sub.en: ctxprof reads Claude Code session logs and attributes recorded usage to system, skill, MCP, file, reasoning and output buckets.
sub.zh: ctxprof 读取 Claude Code 会话日志，将记录的用量归因到系统、Skill、MCP、文件、推理和输出六类。

body.en: Inspect system, skills, MCP, files, reasoning and output.
body.zh: 检查系统、Skill、MCP、文件、推理和输出。

body.en: Cached prefixes are not treated as fresh window capacity on every turn.
body.zh: 累计重复前缀与窗口容量分别展示。

body.en: Trend and compare operate on explicit session files.
body.zh: trend 与 compare 可分析明确指定的会话文件。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Read the complete synthetic session in examples/sample-session.jsonl and render its allocation tree.
note.zh: 读取 examples/sample-session.jsonl 中的完整合成会话，并输出归因树。

steps.label: Recorded run

body.en: Read the complete synthetic session in examples/sample-session.jsonl and render its allocation tree.
body.zh: 读取 examples/sample-session.jsonl 中的完整合成会话，并输出归因树。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/ctxprof.git
cd ctxprof
go build ./cmd/ctxprof

limitations.en: Per-block and per-bucket values are calibrated estimates. The vendored tokenizer is not Anthropic’s proprietary tokenizer.
limitations.zh: 内容块和分类值是校准后的估计，内置 tokenizer 不是 Anthropic 专有 tokenizer。

limitations.en: The example is a synthetic session; its usage numbers are fixture values, not measured savings.
limitations.zh: 示例为合成会话；用量数字来自固定输入，不是实测节省量。

limitations.en: ctxprof diagnoses recorded data and does not unload skills or edit the session.
limitations.zh: ctxprof 诊断已记录数据，不会卸载 Skill 或修改会话。

body.en: An aggregate usage number cannot tell you which loaded content deserves attention. A ranked allocation helps you inspect the largest consumers and compare sessions before changing your workflow.
body.zh: 总用量无法指出应当检查哪些已加载内容。归因排行帮助定位较大消费者，并在调整工作流前比较不同会话。

body.en: The parser reads JSONL turns, a vendored byte-level BPE weights individual blocks, and reconciliation scales those weights to recorded usage. Attribution groups the result into six buckets. The renderer separates peak single-turn window occupancy from cumulative throughput.
body.zh: 解析器读取 JSONL 轮次，内置字节级 BPE 为各内容块估算权重，再对齐到日志中的用量。归因层把结果分入六类，渲染层区分单轮峰值窗口占用与跨轮累计吞吐。

body.en: The parser reads JSONL turns, a vendored byte-level BPE weights individual blocks, and reconciliation scales those weights to recorded usage. Attribution groups the result into six buckets. The renderer separates peak single-turn window occupancy from cumulative throughput.
body.zh: 解析器读取 JSONL 轮次，内置字节级 BPE 为各内容块估算权重，再对齐到日志中的用量。归因层把结果分入六类，渲染层区分单轮峰值窗口占用与跨轮累计吞吐。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: Use --session to select a file explicitly; without it the CLI discovers sessions under ~/.claude/projects/. --window-max sets the window denominator. --json selects structured output; --cut-candidates N adds the largest individual consumers.
body.zh: --session 显式指定文件；省略时从 ~/.claude/projects/ 查找会话。--window-max 设置窗口分母，--json 输出结构化结果，--cut-candidates N 列出较大的单项消费者。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
go run ./cmd/ctxprof --session examples/sample-session.jsonl --json
go run ./cmd/ctxprof --session examples/sample-session.jsonl --cut-candidates 10
# Compare your own sessions, old first:
ctxprof compare old.jsonl new.jsonl --json
ctxprof trend session-a.jsonl session-b.jsonl
